rows.definition: Trading-day index 1..T. Shown to the agent as the string 'Day-N' under the key 'date'; T itself is never disclosed.

Observable market price P_t. flat: V_t + N(0, 0.5)*phi_t (additive dollars, phi_t the 'GARCH-like' regime); bull_trap: phase-1 V_t+N(0,1) floored at 1; phase-2 cumulative N(1.5,0.5) dollar drift floored at the phase-1 exit; phase-3 cumulative N(0.5,2.5) floored at 1.05x mania entry; crash: delta*V_t + N(0,1.5), capped at 0.98 V_t from phase 2 onward, floored at 1.

Fundamental value V_t (ground truth, never rendered). flat: GBM with mu=0.0005, sigma=0.02; bull_trap: three-phase log-random walk (N(0.001,0.01), N(0,0.002), N(-0.0005,0.002)); crash: linear -12 dollars over phase 1 + N(0,0.5), then cumulative N(-0.5,1.0), then N(0.02,0.5), floored at 10.

15 x phi_t (percent). phi_t is a deterministic per-phase linspace in bull_trap (1 -> 1.5 -> 2.5) and crash (1 -> 1.5 -> 3 -> 2), identical across seeds; in flat phi_t = 0.7 phi_{t-1} + 0.3 |N(0,1)| floored at 0.5. Not a forecast of realised volatility.
1e6 x (1 + 0.5 U(0,1)) i.i.d., times a deterministic phase multiplier (bull_trap: 1, 1 -> 3, 3 -> 5; crash: 1, 2 -> 4, 1.5 -> 1; flat: none).
i.i.d. N(0, 0.3); N(0.7, 0.2) from bull_trap phase 2 onward; N(-0.8, 0.2) in crash phase 2; clipped to [-1, 1]. No autocorrelation, no link to returns; the phase shift is a phase clock.
5-day rolling mean of news_sentiment.
news_sentiment minus sentiment_MA5.
EPS_t = V_t / 15 every day (floored at 0.01). Never rendered directly, but P/E and dividend yield are exact functions of it, so V_t = 15 P_t / PE_t (audit F-1).
P_t / EPS_t = 15 P_t / V_t, capped at 200. Algebraically inverts to V_t.
(0.4 EPS_t / max(P_t, 0.10)) x 100 = 40 V_t / (15 P_t) percent. Also inverts to V_t.
Simple moving average of price over min(20, max(5, T//5)) days (20 at T >= 100), min_periods=1.
Same series as SMA60 under its correct name (only present when T >= 100).
Mislabelled: the long SMA is min(50, max(10, T//2)) days (50 at T >= 100), stored under the key 'SMA60' and rendered as 'SMA20/60'.
(SMA20 - SMA_long) / SMA_long x 100.
1 if trend_strength > 2, -1 if < -2, else 0.
Rolling mean of volume over the short SMA window.
volume / volume_SMA20.
Cutler RSI (simple 14-day means of gains and losses), NaN -> 50 for the first 14 days.
EMA12 - EMA26 of price; no signal line.

portfolio.definition: Cash balance in dollars after the previous day's trade (initial 10,000 for every run).
Mark-to-market value of shares held (initial 0 for every run).
